name: DEV TEST — All Types (4min)
description: Test workout covering every drill type, section type, rest_after, repeats, and multi-drill cycling.

name: Beginner 20min (26min) — Steady State
description: Steady-state endurance row at a comfortable pace. Focus on maintaining consistent technique and breathing throughout.

name: Beginner 20min (26min) — Drill Focus
description: Technique-building session progressing through fundamental drills. Each 5-minute block isolates a different part of the stroke.

name: Beginner 20min (26min) — Easy Intervals
description: Gentle 2-minute on/off intervals alternating between moderate and easy pace. A great introduction to interval training.

name: Beginner 30min (36min) — Steady State
description: Extended steady-state row building aerobic base at low intensity. Ideal for developing endurance and a consistent rhythm.

name: Beginner 30min (36min) — Drill Focus
description: Progressive drill session with 6-minute blocks for each stroke component. Longer segments allow deeper focus on each technique.

name: Beginner 30min (36min) — Easy Intervals
description: Alternating 3-minute work and 2-minute recovery intervals. Builds fitness without overwhelming effort.

name: Beginner 30min (36min) — Mixed Drills & Rowing
description: Combines drill segments with free rowing to practice applying technique cues under normal conditions.

name: Beginner 40min (46min) — Steady State
description: Long steady-state session for building aerobic capacity. Maintain relaxed posture and consistent drive throughout.

name: Beginner 40min (46min) — Drill Focus
description: Comprehensive drill workout covering all fundamental stroke components in extended segments.

name: Beginner 40min (46min) — Endurance Build
description: Gradually increasing stroke rate over longer segments. Builds stamina while keeping intensity manageable.

name: Beginner 40min (46min) — Easy Pyramid
description: Ascending and descending stroke rate pyramid. Teaches pace control and body awareness at different intensities.

name: Intermediate 20min (26min) — Intervals
description: Work/rest intervals with higher stroke rates and tension. Develops power and cardiovascular fitness efficiently.

name: Intermediate 20min (26min) — Pyramid
description: Rate pyramid climbing and descending through stroke rates. Challenges pace discipline and power output control.

name: Intermediate 20min (26min) — Drill Focus
description: Advanced drill combinations with higher stroke rates. Reinforces technique under greater intensity.

name: Intermediate 30min (36min) — Intervals
description: Sustained work intervals at race-adjacent stroke rates with structured rest. Builds interval fitness and mental toughness.

name: Intermediate 30min (36min) — Pyramid
description: Extended rate pyramid with longer steps. Tests ability to hold technique across a wide range of stroke rates.

name: Intermediate 30min (36min) — Steady State
description: Moderate-intensity steady row at 22 spm. Builds aerobic power while maintaining good form.

name: Intermediate 30min (36min) — Mixed Drills & Power
description: Alternates drill segments with high-power rowing. Applies technique focus directly into powerful strokes.

name: Intermediate 40min (46min) — Intervals
description: Longer interval session with progressive intensity. Develops sustained power output and recovery capacity.

name: Intermediate 40min (46min) — Pyramid
description: Full ascending/descending pyramid across a wide stroke rate range. A thorough pace control challenge.

name: Intermediate 40min (46min) — Endurance
description: Extended moderate-intensity row building deep aerobic fitness. Focus on efficiency and relaxation at pace.

name: Intermediate 40min (46min) — Drill Endurance
description: Long drill-focused session mixing technique work with sustained rowing. Embeds good habits over distance.

name: Advanced 20min (26min) — Power Intervals
description: High-intensity intervals at elevated stroke rates and tension. Targets maximal power output in short bursts.

name: Advanced 20min (26min) — Sprint Pyramid
description: Aggressive rate pyramid peaking at 30+ spm. Develops top-end speed and rapid rate changes.

name: Advanced 20min (26min) — High-Intensity Drills
description: Drill work at high stroke rates and tension. Forces technical precision under race-like conditions.

name: Advanced 30min (36min) — Power Intervals
description: Extended high-power interval session with structured rest. Builds sustained power and lactate tolerance.

name: Advanced 30min (36min) — Pyramid
description: Steep rate pyramid with tight transitions. Challenges cardiovascular capacity and stroke rate agility.

name: Advanced 30min (36min) — Race Pace
description: Sustained race-pace rowing at 26-28 spm. Simulates competitive intensity for mental and physical preparation.

name: Advanced 30min (36min) — Tabata Style
description: Tabata-inspired 20s on / 10s off bursts. Pushes anaerobic capacity with minimal recovery windows.

name: Advanced 40min (46min) — Power Intervals
description: Long high-intensity interval session. Demands sustained effort across many work bouts with disciplined recovery.

name: Advanced 40min (46min) — Endurance
description: Demanding steady-state row at elevated pace. Tests ability to hold technique and power over extended time.

name: Advanced 40min (46min) — Race Simulation
description: Full race simulation with progressive pace increases. Mimics the strategic pacing of a competitive 2k/5k race.

name: Advanced 40min (46min) — Pyramid
description: Grand pyramid covering the full stroke rate spectrum. The ultimate pace control and endurance challenge.

name: Interval 6x2min (23min)
description: Classic 6x2-minute interval workout with 60-second rest. A staple Concept2 format for building speed and power.

name: Tabata 4min (10min)
description: True Tabata protocol: 8 rounds of 20s max effort / 10s rest. Short but brutally effective for anaerobic fitness.

name: Pyramid with Rest (28min)
description: Ascending duration pyramid (1-5 minutes) with 90-second rest between steps. Combines endurance and interval training.

name: 30/30 Sprint Intervals (12min)
description: Short sprint intervals alternating 30 seconds of hard effort with 30 seconds of rest. Builds explosive power and anaerobic capacity.

name: 5x5min Threshold (36min)
description: Five 5-minute pieces at threshold pace with 60-second rest. Develops lactate threshold and sustained power output.

name: Ratings Ladder (34min)
description: Ascending stroke rate ladder stepping through 4, 3, 2, and 1-minute segments at increasing pace. Teaches rate control and smooth transitions.

name: Speed Pyramid 5-4-3-2-1 (26min)
description: Descending duration pyramid from 5 minutes down to 1 minute with increasing stroke rate. Builds speed as fatigue accumulates.

name: 12x30s Max Effort (33min)
description: Twelve 30-second bursts at maximum effort with generous 2-minute rest. Develops peak power and sprint repeatability.

name: 10x90s On/Off (36min)
description: Ten 90-second work pieces alternating with 90-second rest. Equal work-to-rest ratio develops sustained high-intensity capacity.

name: Balanced 10x2:30 (36min)
description: Ten 2:30 work intervals with short 30-second transitions. High volume with minimal rest builds aerobic power and mental endurance.

name: Stroke Rate Wave (36min)
description: Wave pattern alternating between low, medium, and high stroke rates across 10 three-minute segments. Develops smooth rate transitions.

name: 4x4min Aerobic (26min)
description: Four 4-minute pieces at steady aerobic intensity with 2-minute rest. A classic Concept2 workout for building aerobic base.

name: Marathon Prep 60min
description: Long steady-state session simulating marathon rowing pace. Builds deep aerobic endurance and mental resilience for extended efforts.

name: Concept2 First Strokes (15min)
description: Very first rowing session from Concept2. Short 3-minute intervals with breaks to stretch and reset form between sets.

name: Concept2 Stroke Rate Explorer (20min)
description: Learn to change stroke rates deliberately while keeping consistent form. Progressive rate increases from 20 to 24 spm with rest between.

name: British Rowing Go Row — Week 1 (14min)
description: Official British Rowing beginner program entry. Very short 1-minute intervals with equal rest, designed for absolute beginners.

name: British Rowing Go Row — Week 4 (18min)
description: Progressed version from British Rowing with longer 5-minute work blocks. Builds aerobic base and confidence for sustained rowing.

name: Concept2 Two Tens (29min)
description: First sustained rowing effort from Concept2. Two 10-minute pieces build endurance and pacing awareness with a rest break between.

name: Technique Drills Circuit (18min)
description: Isolate parts of the rowing stroke using drills. Arms-only through full stroke, then pause drills for timing. Based on Concept2 drill recommendations.

name: Pete Plan — Beginner Week 1 (26min)
description: Entry point for the famous Pete Plan program. 20 minutes of steady state at low rate to build aerobic base. Focus on consistent split and pacing.

name: Concept2 1min On/Off (24min)
description: Classic Concept2 interval session. Alternating 1 minute hard and 1 minute easy for 10 rounds builds both aerobic and anaerobic capacity.

name: 3-2-1 Stroke Rate Pyramid (30min)
description: Pyramid cycling through 3-2-1 minute blocks at increasing stroke rates, repeated 4 times. Teaches rate changes and pacing discipline.

name: Ascending Ladder 1-2-3-4-3-2-1 (29min)
description: Classic pyramid ladder where work intervals ascend then descend. Rest is half the preceding work interval. Builds pacing awareness and mental toughness.

name: 8x1min Speed Intervals (23min)
description: Short high-intensity 1-minute intervals with generous 90-second rest. Builds speed and power with near-full recovery between efforts. Based on CrossFit rowing.

name: 3x12min Aerobic Build (46min)
description: Three 12-minute blocks at progressively increasing stroke rates. Develops aerobic endurance at threshold effort, simulating race-build strategy.

name: HIIT 30/30 Sprint Blitz (22min)
description: Two rounds of 30-second max sprints with equal rest. 10 sprints then a break then 5 more. Builds explosive power and anaerobic capacity.

name: Fat-Oxidation (41min) - created by Gemini

name: Power Endurance (35min) - created by Gemini
description: Heavy pulls at variable rates to force muscle recruitment.

name: The Step-Up 40 (46min) - created by Gemini
description: Increasing intensity every 10 minutes. A mental and physical grind.

name: Metabolic Wave (36min) - created by Gemini
description: Fluctuating between aerobic and anaerobic work. High HR variability.

description: Ultimate fat burner. Low stroke rate but high power per stroke.

name: 5000m Simulation (26min) - created by Gemini
description: Simulates a long-distance race pace with high resistance.

name: Threshold 45 (51min) - created by Gemini
description: Long intervals at your upper aerobic limit. High calorie output.

name: The Long Slow Burn (75min) - created by Gemini
description: Ultimate fat-burning session for days when you have plenty of time.
